verdict.rationale: Zep is fundamentally API/SDK-driven (thread.add_messages, graph.edge.delete calls) and ships a full-access CLI (zepctl) for managing projects, users, threads, and data from the terminal — both of which are inherently scriptable/headless and usable in CI pipelines. However, there is no explicit documentation or example of CI/CD integration, automated testing, or headless deployment guidance. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD pipeline examples, headless automation docs, non-interactive auth/service-account setup guidance for CI.
